metadata.title: Health Literacy and Communication in Stroke Prevention, Management, and Recovery: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
top_takeaways: Health literacy mismatches strongly impact stroke outcomes, yet the supporting literature suffers from methodological heterogeneity and a lack of validated measures. Practicing neurologists should implement nurse-led, literacy-sensitive communication strategies—such as teach-back education and tailored digital support—while ensuring emerging AI and telehealth tools are rigorously evaluated to maintain equity.
